reason: I want to build the heat store first; a coil in an insulated water tank seems suited to capturing processor heat.
expectation: The coil and tank will form a heat-storage assembly, possibly still needing connection to the exchanger.

alternatives.reason: The quilt and frames seem useful for the screen, but I want to start with heat recovery.

effect: The coil and tank form the expected water heat store; it still needs water and a heat source.
reaction: The assembly makes physical sense, though the result gives little detail yet.
reason: Fill the store so water can hold heat.
expectation: The tank will be filled and ready to connect to the processor exchanger.

alternatives.reason: I could build the screen first, but want to finish the heat store.

effect: The store is filled as expected, and the exchanger is now available for connecting it.
reaction: A straightforward preparatory step; nothing especially surprising.
reason: Connect the filled store to the processor's heat exchanger to capture its waste heat.
expectation: The water will be warmed by the processor and stored for later use.

alternatives.reason: The screen remains another goal, but the heat store is ready to connect.

effect: The charged tank keeps the root zone warm after the processor stops, completing the heat storage goal.
reaction: I like the concrete connection between waste heat and keeping roots warm at night.
reason: The remaining combination joins quilt and frame to start the adjustable bench screen.
expectation: It will make a framed reflective screen, perhaps needing installation on the bench.

effect: The quilt and frame made an insulated screen, ready to fit to the bench.
reaction: The result is as expected; I am curious how it adjusts.
reason: Fit the screen to the bench to complete the remaining goal; it is the only gameplay option.
expectation: The bench gains an adjustable insulated screen for warmth.

effect: Fitting the screen created an insulated growing nook and completed the chapter; I still do not know how the screen adjusts.
reaction: The nook is a pleasing outcome, though I wanted a more concrete picture of its use.

mostWorthwhile.text: Charging the water store and learning that retained processor heat carries the root zone through part of the night made the practical purpose clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the store was a predictable intermediate step with little detail of its own.

surprise.text: I had expected heat storage for the cabin generally; the result specifically connected it to the root zone.

arbitrary.text: The combinations had clear purposes, but the final screen result did not explain how it adjusts or how the bench becomes a growing nook.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see what comes of the ridged fragment and how the station develops. This chapter's heat reuse was satisfying, though the choices mostly selected an obvious order.
